scope: A sufficient upper bound for one immutable v2 recipient route current canonical witness image; not an exact maximum feasible window.
derivation: Schema objects and column names come from the built-in trusted in-memory SQL schema; profile, key check, namespace and encoded context are exact configured values.
All live facts, signed evidence envelopes/controls and latest signed retirement offer are validated through retention_wire.frame; their plaintext lengths are each at most 8192 bytes.
StateVault adds exactly 36 bytes (8-byte header, 12-byte nonce, 16-byte tag), so each protected field is at most 8228 bytes. Hex serialization doubles byte payload length.
Metadata high/floor are fixed 8-byte BLOBs, root is 32 bytes, observed time is a nonnegative integer at most 2^62. The non-null maximal latest offer dominates its initial null representation.
Live rows contain 8-byte sequence, 64-character lowercase hexadecimal derived identity, encrypted fact and encrypted evidence. Fixed text has no JSON escaping expansion.
Use actual pack_cell and canonical JSON to serialize one maximal metadata row with empty live array: length M. Serialize one maximal live row and one comma: length L.
For n>0 rows, maximum envelope length is M+n*L-1; for zero rows it is M. Sorting rows changes order, not length. Validated live interval bounds n<=W, hence image bytes <= M+W*L.

Admit only when M+W*L <= the current configured witness MAX_IMAGE. The gate runs before connecting to or creating the recipient SQLite file and before any authority call. A changed limit is rechecked on reopen/restore.

This intentionally charges the full frame maximum independently to facts, evidence and latest offer; actual legal objects may be much smaller. Rejecting W above the sufficient bound does not prove that every possible workload would overflow.

checks: oversized context rejects before recipient file creation or authority head change
bound-sized cap admitted and one byte less rejected
maximum-width context and maximal protected-field serializer fixture near 16 MiB
actual StateVault overhead and real accept/retire/restore image lifecycle
incompatible reopen limit and malformed limits reject without state mutation
validation.limitations: The saturation fixture uses fake ciphertext to exercise storage serialization, rolled back without authority publication. Actual signed lifecycle is separately tested with small window and mixed jobs; no maximum-window valid-event performance claim.

compatibility: No database schema change or implicit context mutation. Existing route whose configured W fails the new conservative gate cannot be opened by this build; no automatic shrink, epoch reset or erasure. Deployment/migration and offline recovery tooling are not provided.
excluded: network scheduling and public timing observations
remaining: Tighter field-specific admission bounds if required by workloads
Authenticated deployment configuration and recovery policy for changed storage limits
Scalable journal and bounded aggregate resources
Independent security/interop review, production nonrollback and full P2/observation proof
